assessments.reasoning: The verified detail identifies Vixie-Cron. Its decoded licenseText matches the bounded notice at 96 tokens. The template, HTML and cross-reference evaluation are separate metadata. Deprecation and OSI approval are both false. [SPDX detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/Vixie-Cron.json)

The digest-verified SPDX text is byte-identical to decoded licenseText. Tokenization accounts for the publisher's comment prefixes and wrapping and retains the copyright years, sale condition and complete disclaimer. [SPDX text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/Vixie-Cron.txt)

The pinned vixie/cron README attributes the opening notice to Paul Vixie and identifies Vixie Cron V3.0 later in the file. The captured passage spans bytes [0,587), including comment punctuation. The computed full hash matches the claim's publisher revision. [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vixie/cron/545b3f5246824a9cda5905eeb7cf019c95e66995/README)

The unsigned annotated object gives v3.29.0 and commit target 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the revision in both Vixie-Cron URLs. [Annotated tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Compare ordered lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs from the opening Paul Vixie copyright through the disclaimer's final user line. Test whether including the rest of the README breaks equality and check the negative SPDX cross-reference flag. Verify both exact URL pins and recompute the full capture hashes.
challenge.results: The three bounded passages yield the same 96 tokens, or 92 with internal apostrophes retained. The rest of the README adds 496 tokens, so whole-file equality fails. Excluded material includes contact information, release history, platform discussion, discussion of a possible separate fee arrangement, installation notes and an RCS marker. The SPDX repository-tree cross-reference reports match=false. Both direct SPDX payloads reproduce the bounded README notice.

limitations: The comparison is limited to the opening copyright and terms through the disclaimer. The two SPDX files share one revision and are representations of the same payload.

SPDX deprecation status is confirmed for 3.29.0. Index lifecycle assignments are unverified because the supplied sources contain no Index lifecycle record. Legal equivalence, rights for other works, reuse and installation are outside scope.
reasoning: The 96-token correspondence and exact Vixie-Cron identifier reproduce against both data files at the annotated release target. The full-file comparison confirms that the README boundary is material.
